description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic and Greek/Coptic numerals. Dating unknown (maybe ~13th or 14th century). Having to do with capitation tax collection and delivery? Several entries on recto are of the form: al-wārid ʿalā yad X bi-l-Qāhira al-Maḥrūsa min jihat al-Miṣriyyīn. The dates are then given according to the Muuslim calendar (but the year is always stated as "in the same year"). In one case the person delivering the payments is Ibrāhīm al-Ḥāshir (i.e., the tax collector). The facing page has a long list of names accompanied by numerals. Needs further examination.
